- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `security`: Security enhancement or vulnerability patch
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, tooling, or build configuration changes
- [ ] `test`: Adding or modifying tests

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] Tested locally (`npm run dev` or `npm run build`)
- [ ] Verified API endpoint behavior and error handling (if backend changes included)
- [ ] Checked for console warnings or errors
- [ ] Responsive design verified (if UI changes included)
